from pathlib import Path
import re
in_path=Path('/inputs/report.html')
out_path=Path('/work/report.html')
orig=in_path.read_bytes()
needle=b'</head>'
idx=orig.find(needle)
if idx==-1:
    raise SystemExit('No </head> tag found')
insert=(
    b'<meta name="description" content="AutoML model evaluation: metrics, visualizations & conclusions (preview)">\n'
    b'<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">\n'
)
new=orig[:idx]+insert+orig[idx:]
out_path.write_bytes(new)

# checks
written=out_path.read_bytes()
assert written==new
# unchanged outside insertion
assert written[:idx]==orig[:idx]
assert written[idx+len(insert):]==orig[idx:]

s=written.decode('utf-8')
# exactly one each (case-insensitive, name attr exact value)
for name in ['description','robots']:
    matches=list(re.finditer(r'<meta\\b[^>]*\\bname\\s*=\\s*(["\'])'+name+r'\\1[^>]*>',s,re.I))
    print(name,'count',len(matches))

# show inserted area
start=max(0,idx-40)
end=idx+len(insert)+20
